case.title: One other submission at identical coordinates must not be topped up by the target itself

submissions.open_text: Shop owner shares the hand pump with six neighbouring plots.
Grandmother pays a cart seller forty shillings per twenty litres.
Teacher praises the new standpipe installed by the county last year.

case.why: Probes the off-by-one on 'other submissions'. dup is 0 m from t on the same local day, so it counts. far is 0.0027 deg south, about 300 m, so it does not. That is one qualifying neighbour, and same_spot must not fire. An implementation that includes t in its own neighbour count, since t is at distance 0 from itself, would reach 2 and fire wrongly. One that dedups identical coordinates is irrelevant here: the answer is still 1. Times are 10:15, 12:00 and 15:00, so there is no burst. far at lat -0.0827 is still inside Kondele.
